content.comment_body: Hello [product_name] users, here is an example showing how to visualize times as a bargraph on the display. Used products: [product_name] [article_no] and [product_name] [version_no]. Issue: The bargraph function cannot directly display the running time of an Off-Delay function block, and such blocks are not selectable in the bargraph's input list. Solution: You can transfer the value to an analog amplifier, for instance. By mapping the value to V-Memory through the VM-mapping table and then using an analog network input to read it and forward to an analog amplifier, you can use this value for the bargraph visualization. Enjoy testing this example!

analysis.insight_summary: A user shared a method for displaying time information as a bargraph on a [product_name] display, highlighting that the bargraph feature does not directly allow using the Off-Delay block. The workaround involves using VM-mapping and analog amplifier functionality. This demonstrates a limitation in the product’s time-based visualization capabilities.
